description: Elections Commission - R. M. S. Piyankara was selected as the member of the Kolonnawa Urban Council - D. J. S. N. Sanjeewa was selected as the member of the Galle Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kolonnawa Urban Council and Galle Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of selected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election processes and related matters.
